title: صيد الضبّان Wiki
seo_title: صيد الضبّان Wiki: Hunt Lizards and Build Wealth
meta_description: Hunt lizards in the Roblox game صيد الضبّان, sell them at the market to build wealth, and see why hunting farther from town pays more and what to watch for.
description_md:
In صيد الضبّان, you leave الديرة (town) for البر (the open desert) and hunt الضبّان (lizards). Then you take your catch to السوق (the market) and sell it, and the sales build your wealth.

Hunting isn't the only thing to do out there. You can camp, light a fire, and have coffee with friends. Abandoned places also hold rare minerals for weapon upgrades. At night, don't follow the فانوس (lantern) that walks by itself.
tips_md:
- Head farther from الديرة for better catches. There are more than 120 lizard types, and the rarer, pricier ones show up farther out.
- Buy and drive a pickup, but keep it out of the sinking sand, since sand can get it stuck.
- Keep an eye out for أبو الضبان (Abu Al-Dhiban). It shows up every so often, and catching it makes you a legend.
